name: Theme Selector
description: Allows changing the page theme via a query-string parameter.
project_description:
This simple module allows you to change the theme of a page with just a query string, using Theme Negotiator.

 How to change the page theme: 

 
 Install Theme Selector module using composer and enable it. 
 Go to /admin/config/user-interface/theme-selector and add a Theme Selector. 
 Select the Theme and the associated sufix. 
 Using the query string ?theme-selector you'll be able to change the page theme. 
 
 Example: 

 https://example.com?theme-selector=bartik 

 Important note: Since this module uses a query parameter page cache is going to be disabled
